items.name: Symbol Switchboard
items.depicts: A black switchboard frame with five grey jack blocks on the left wired by criss-crossing yellow and orange patch cords to five amber blocks on the right.

items.name: ELF Header
items.depicts: A grey-framed dark plate with a deep blue header band above a short yellow bar and a longer grey bar.

items.name: Trampoline Bridge
items.depicts: Two dark vertical panels framed in grey and yellow, bridged across a central gap by crossing orange and teal diagonal tracks.

items.name: Offset Fixup
items.depicts: Two vertical blocks, one bright yellow and one brown, threaded side by side onto a single horizontal grey rail.

items.name: Indirection Ledger
items.depicts: A grey-framed black panel holding four horizontal bars, three dark grey and the second illuminated in bright yellow.

items.name: SONAME Tag
items.depicts: A brown-framed cream plaque showing a long dark-grey bar above a shorter brown bar, like a two-line name and version plate.

items.name: RPATH Signpost
items.depicts: Three vertical bars in yellow, teal, and orange spaced evenly across a single horizontal grey rail.

items.name: Deferred Resolver
items.depicts: A grey-bordered white card containing a dark grey horizontal bar over a shorter bright-yellow bar.

items.name: Bind-Time Beetle
items.depicts: A small brown boxy creature with a yellow top ridge, two stubby grey legs underneath, and a pale-yellow plug prong extending to the right.

items.name: Unbound Plug
items.depicts: A smaller legless brown block with a pale-yellow top-left tab and a bright-yellow prong projecting to the right.
